summary: 73-year-old Lafayette woman missing after lunch with hiking partners on Buchanan Pass Trail near Allenspark; multi-day search found no trace; remains found ~2014 near Thunderbolt Creek
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Boulder County Sheriff; Grand County SAR; Alpine Rescue Team; Larimer County SAR; Front Range Rescue Dogs
